dependencies.source: Colbois-Dryden-El Soufi, Bounding the eigenvalues of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on compact submanifolds
dependencies.role: Unbounded scale-invariant first positive eigenvalue for smooth compact connected hypersurfaces: varying topology in dimension 2, fixed hypersurface-embeddable manifold in dimensions at least 3.
dependencies.inspection_limit: The theorem and full Section 5 were inspected by the independent audit; underlying Colbois-Dodziuk and arithmetic-surface results are not reproved.

dependencies.source: Nash (1954), Kuiper (1955), C1 isometric-embedding theorems; precise formulation in De Lellis-Szekelyhidi, John Nash's nonlinear iteration
dependencies.role: C0-dense C1 isometric embeddings in codimension one from a smooth short embedding, permitting prescribed small-ball containment.
dependencies.inspection_limit: The modern precise theorem and immediate context were inspected; separate retrieval of the original Nash and Kuiper articles is not claimed.

dependencies.source: Hirsch, Differential Topology, Graduate Texts in Mathematics 33, Springer (1976)
dependencies.location: p. 50, as invoked in CDE Section 5
dependencies.role: C1 approximation of compact C1 embeddings by smooth embeddings; the proof supplies the metric-comparison, spectral-continuity and exact-area-rescaling steps.
dependencies.inspection_limit: Only the CDE invocation was inspected; no separate retrieval of Hirsch's book is claimed.

dependencies.location: Standard smooth compact connected embedded hypersurface form
dependencies.role: A connected smooth embedded compact hypersurface has bounded and unbounded complementary components with that boundary.
dependencies.inspection_limit: Used as a named standard topological theorem; not independently reproved in this note.

dependencies.source: Bruno Colbois, Upper bounds for the spectrum of Riemannian manifolds, Oberwolfach Report 33/2012
dependencies.location: Printed pp. 2034-2036; Theorem 3 and additive question on p. 2036
dependencies.role: Exact problem statement and domain/spectrum scope; the complete talk imposes no connected-boundary requirement.

dependencies.source: Colbois-El Soufi-Girouard, Isoperimetric control of the spectrum of a compact hypersurface
dependencies.role: Known multiplicative estimate and source convention allowing disconnected boundary and counting all zero modes. Example 3.1 is not itself the Euclidean counterexample.
dependencies.inspection_limit: Inspected preprint is arXiv v2 revised 2011; the later compilation date is not evidence of a new 2022 result.

authored_argument: Metric comparison, prescribed area/gap in a small ball, connected two-component cavity domain, exact sphere-mode rank, and all-constants asymptotic contradiction. These are complete in PROOF.md; no novelty or priority claim is made.
limitations: For each fixed integer m >= 2; no assertion in dimension 1.
The domain itself is connected, bounded and smooth; the boundary has exactly two connected components.
No result for the connected-boundary variant is claimed.
Intrinsic Laplace-Beltrami spectrum of the induced boundary metric, counting all zero modes and multiplicities from index 1.
For m=2 the cavity genus may vary; for m>=3 the cavity can be diffeomorphic to S^m.
Established geometric existence and topology results are explicit dependencies; no numerical embedding or finite diagnostic proves them.
The known multiplicative estimate and fixed-domain Weyl asymptotics are unaffected.
No historical novelty, priority, external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal machine proof is claimed.
